technical.summary: DHI shows strong bullish structure with price above all key MAs and positive volume confirmation, but overbought RSI conditions and lack of fresh crossover signals suggest limited upside potential for swing entry at current levels.

fundamental.summary: DHI shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signals, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and elevated earnings risk within 39 days—fundamentals lack bullish catalysts.

sentiment.summary: No congressional signal; mixed sentiment with fear reading (38) presents potential contrarian opportunity, but lack of news data and small-scale junior member trades limit conviction.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (240+) indicates extreme market stress, FOMC just concluded with tightening bias, and Consumer Discretionary sector faces demand destruction in recessionary environment; earnings in 39 days adds moderate event risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Price above all major moving averages with positive volume confirmation and RSI momentum suggests structural strength, and fear-zone sentiment presents contrarian opportunity for reversal.
debate.key_bear_argument: Severe macro headwinds (inverted yield curve, VIX crisis levels, recession signals), overbought technicals (RSI 72.67, StochRSI overbought), zero fundamental catalysts, earnings risk in 39 days, and Consumer Discretionary sector demand destruction make this a mature move into headwinds.

decision.entry_rationale: Already holding DHI with existing position; macro environment severely unfavourable (inverted yield curve, VIX crisis, recession signals) outweighs technical strength and contrarian sentiment opportunity.
decision.primary_risk: Consumer Discretionary demand destruction in recessionary environment combined with earnings event in 39 days creates asymmetric downside risk; overbought technicals offer no margin of safety.
decision.recommended_exit: N/A — skip entry; manage existing position with trailing stop at ATR 1x given macro headwinds.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bear case; technical strength insufficient to overcome macro risk and fundamental weakness.
decision.portfolio_note: Already exposed to DHI and 22 other Consumer Discretionary positions; adding concentration in sector facing demand destruction during recession signals is imprudent risk management.
